gates.requirement: The research question, justification-evidence status, falsifier, and requirement for a simpler baseline are explicit and frozen.
Every proposed dataset item requires explicit rights, consent status, attribution, retention, disclosure, and source-record provenance.
Self-generated items remain identifiable and carry generator provenance; dataset manifests never imply that source bytes were verified.
A DSQ-derived representation is compared with an ordinary-segment baseline under qualification and budget controls; neither is described as a universal particle system.
Fine-tuning has no selected base model, remains not started, and requires separate authorization.
Analysis, generation, and held-out simpler-baseline tasks are preregistered without executing evaluation or asserting learned gains.
Recursive evaluation cannot revise the ontology or its benchmark definitions.
CPU, GPU, memory, storage, energy-accounting, and offline network bounds are explicit before any separately authorized execution.
The model-card template, failure categories, capability revocation, readable earlier bundles, and return to deterministic or external baselines are frozen.
The custom-model route ends in a separate authorization and cannot be inferred from infrastructure conformance.
Invalid governance, provenance, split, digest, authorization, or execution claims create durable failure or refusal receipts without a research artifact.

Conformance uses synthetic declaration fixtures only and performs no data collection, byte access, checkpoint download, training, generation, evaluation, human interaction, network access, or public projection.
